posts.text:
Trump has revealed how easily our system can be abused.

It is not enough to merely oppose him.

We must end such abuses by reforming how our government functions.
posts.summary: Demands systemic government reforms to prevent Trump-style abuses
posts.quote:
Trump has revealed how easily our system can be abused.

It is not enough to merely oppose him.

We must end such abuses by reforming how our government functions.

posts.text:
10. Eliminate the Electoral College and base the selection of president and vice president on the overall popular vote.

This can effectively be done through a compact among states to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential ticket wins the national popular vote.
posts.summary: Advocates eliminating Electoral College for national popular vote
posts.quote:
10. Eliminate the Electoral College and base the selection of president and vice president on the overall popular vote.

This can effectively be done through a compact among states to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential ticket wins the national popular vote.

posts.text:
9. Tax large aggregations of personal wealth.

Eliminate the “stepped-up basis at death” rule that allows large fortunes to be transferred from one generation to the next without paying taxes on capital gains.

Enact a wealth tax.
posts.summary: Proposes wealth tax and eliminating stepped-up basis loophole
posts.quote:
9. Tax large aggregations of personal wealth.

Eliminate the “stepped-up basis at death” rule that allows large fortunes to be transferred from one generation to the next without paying taxes on capital gains.

Enact a wealth tax.

posts.text:
8. Get big money out of politics and overturn Citizens United.

Establish public matching funds for small-dollar donations for all federal elected offices.

Encourage states to grant corporate charters only on the condition that corporations refrain from political activity.
posts.summary: Calls for campaign finance reform and overturning Citizens United
posts.quote:
8. Get big money out of politics and overturn Citizens United.

Establish public matching funds for small-dollar donations for all federal elected offices.

Encourage states to grant corporate charters only on the condition that corporations refrain from political activity.

posts.text:
7. Protect the freedom of inquiry.

Bar the executive branch from conditioning research or other educational grants to universities on any ideological litmus test. Researchers should be free to pursue the truth.
posts.summary: Opposes ideological litmus tests for university research grants
posts.quote:
7. Protect the freedom of inquiry.

Bar the executive branch from conditioning research or other educational grants to universities on any ideological litmus test. Researchers should be free to pursue the truth.

posts.text:
6. Protect press freedom and independence.

Amend the Sherman and Clayton antitrust acts to bar large corporations, or any person already owning major media, from purchasing major media networks or platforms.
posts.summary: Proposes antitrust restrictions on large media purchases
posts.quote:
6. Protect press freedom and independence.

Amend the Sherman and Clayton antitrust acts to bar large corporations, or any person already owning major media, from purchasing major media networks or platforms.

posts.text:
5. Revive voting rights.

Reenact Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (which barred voting procedures that discriminate on the basis of race) and Section 5 (which required jurisdictions with a history of voter suppression to obtain federal approval before changing voting laws.)
posts.summary: Calls for reenacting Voting Rights Act protections
posts.quote:
5. Revive voting rights.

Reenact Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (which barred voting procedures that discriminate on the basis of race) and Section 5 (which required jurisdictions with a history of voter suppression to obtain federal approval before changing voting laws.)

posts.text:
4. End the gerrymandering wars once and for all.

Require states to create independent commissions to draw congressional district lines.
posts.summary: Advocates independent commissions to end partisan gerrymandering
posts.quote:
4. End the gerrymandering wars once and for all.

Require states to create independent commissions to draw congressional district lines.

posts.text:
3. Stop a president from abusing the Justice Department.

Prohibit a president from having any involvement in decisions about whom to prosecute and require congressional review of any pardons or commutations.
posts.summary: Proposes presidential DOJ independence and congressional pardon review
posts.quote:
3. Stop a president from abusing the Justice Department.

Prohibit a president from having any involvement in decisions about whom to prosecute and require congressional review of any pardons or commutations.

posts.text:
2. Prevent conflicts of interest.

End the exemption of the president and vice president from conflicts of interest laws.

Require all federally elected officials to put their investments into blind trusts.

Prohibit all trading of specific shares of stock.
posts.summary: Demands conflict-of-interest laws and blind trusts for federal officials
posts.quote:
2. Prevent conflicts of interest.

End the exemption of the president and vice president from conflicts of interest laws.

Require all federally elected officials to put their investments into blind trusts.

Prohibit all trading of specific shares of stock.

posts.text:
1. Subject Supreme Court justices to term limits.

Limit the terms of justices to 18 years, after which they must move to courts of appeals or district courts.

Those who are beyond this limit must immediately move to other courts.
posts.summary: Proposes 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices
posts.quote:
1. Subject Supreme Court justices to term limits.

Limit the terms of justices to 18 years, after which they must move to courts of appeals or district courts.

Those who are beyond this limit must immediately move to other courts.
